primary_question_answer: This smoke run validated additional local infrastructure and traceability fixes, but it did not validate generated skill effectiveness.
status_basis: The first train attempt reproduced a generation robustness crash caused by a non-string dedup_notes field.
After patching generation field coercion, the train rerun completed with exit code 0.
The persisted skill included source_candidate_id matching the generated candidate id.
Construction verification selected two baseline failures in an all-failure training sample but had net_gain 0, so the skill was deprecated.
Held-out smoke eval completed with exit code 0, but skipped real skill-condition eval because the skill was deprecated.
validated_fixes: real local Ollama smoke command ran through train/eval
generation parser no longer crashes on list-valued dedup_notes
all-failure verification sample selects target failures
deprecated skill eval policy records skill==baseline
remaining_gaps: Generated skill effectiveness remains not validated.
The smoke model produced zero baseline successes and no successful repairs.
A larger confirmation with held-out repair opportunity is still needed.
